title: Joins IBM's San Jose Development Laboratory
description: After graduating from Purdue University (MS in Engineering) and Santa Clara University (MBA), joins the development laboratory staff at IBM in Silicon Valley.

title: Published in Electronics Magazine
description: Publishes 'Noise simulators help find peril in power-line defects' (Electronics, 7 March 1966), detailing testing methodologies for data-processing equipment against power disturbances.

title: Returns to India, Joins IBM India
description: Returns to India to lead national export operations at IBM India, building the foundational bridges between Indian engineering and global computing markets.

title: Co-Founds Pentax Engineering
description: Following IBM's exit from India, acquires the former manufacturing facility alongside ex-IBM colleagues to continue precision electronics production.

title: Tandon Magnetics
description: Founds Tandon Magnetics at SEEPZ, Mumbai, pioneering the design and precision manufacturing of computing and storage technology, including magnetic recording heads for floppy disk drives.

title: National Export Award
description: Tandon Magnetics receives the National Award for outstanding export performance, conferred by the President of India.

title: Tandon Magnetics Acquired by Western Digital
description: Tandon Magnetics' hard drive and recording head manufacturing operations sold to Western Digital in 1984, establishing a landmark global technology exit.

title: Leads the Export Processing Zones Movement
description: Serves as Chairman of FEPZAI and SEEMA, championing export infrastructure and securing historic legal rights for women to work night shifts in SEEPZ.

title: Tandon Motors (Joint Venture with Kollmorgen)
description: Joint venture with Kollmorgen to design and manufacture motion technologies. Now operating as part of Danaher Motion.

title: Electronics Man of the Year
description: Named Electronics Man of the Year (1997–98) by ELCINA in recognition of transformative contributions to Indian hardware manufacturing and exports.

title: Celetronix
description: Partnered with Flextronics and New Enterprise Associates (NEA) to launch India's largest electronics manufacturing company serving global OEMs. Sold to Jabil Circuit in 2006.

title: IQ BackOffice
description: Established technology partnership to provide accounts payable outsourcing services. Successfully sold to the Ayala Group in 2012.

title: Syrma Technology
description: Launched magnetics design and manufacturing company specializing in RFID technologies and contract manufacturing services serving global OEMs and the growing Indian market.

title: Memory Electronics
description: Launched Memory Electronics, a Government of India licensed defense electronics equipment manufacturer delivering mission-critical hardware.

title: Accelyst Solutions (FreeCharge.com)
description: Incubated and launched India's unique payments and loyalty platform. Reached 20 million users within 4 years and partnered with Sequoia Capital.

title: Infinx Healthcare
description: Launched healthcare information technology company providing revenue cycle management (RCM) solutions to leading US healthcare systems.

title: Critical Entry Data Systems
description: Acquired company that provided prescription processing and billing services to long term care and mail order pharmacies.

title: FreeCharge Acquired by Snapdeal
description: Sold to Snapdeal in India's largest e-commerce technology acquisition to date.

title: Chairman, Tandon Group
description: Guides the Tandon Group as an international technology incubator, fostering next-generation enterprises across electronics, healthcare, and software.
